The event marks the second assault on the capital within days, following a strike on Thursday that damaged the Public Investment Fund tower, the city's tallest skyscraper. Witnesses in Riyadh observed a projectile leaving a smoke trail before a loud detonation was heard.

The cross-border escalation follows coalition airstrikes on the Red Sea port of Hodeidah and military sites in Sanaa. In response, the Houthis threatened Saudi Red Sea ports, warned aircraft to avoid national airspace, and claimed responsibility for attacks targeting southern Saudi infrastructure. The ongoing conflict has created severe regional disruptions alongside parallel military actions involving the United States and Iran.

Concurrently, the Yemeni army reported that its 'Dawn of Yemen' operation neutralized 193 Houthi leaders and fighters across 854 recent engagements. Army spokesman Majed al-Nazili stated that government forces, supported by the Popular Resistance, utilized airstrikes, artillery, and drones to destroy numerous military vehicles and fortifications on multiple fronts.

This military campaign matters as it reflects a severe escalation of a conflict that reignited in July after a 2022 stalemate, worsening the humanitarian crisis in Yemen and security challenges for Saudi Arabia since hostilities began in 2014.

stories.title: KL Rahul Century Puts India in Control Against New Zealand in Wellington
stories.summary:
India finished the third day of the first Test against New Zealand at 486-4 at the Basin Reserve in Wellington, holding a lead of 118 runs with two days remaining in the match. KL Rahul anchored the innings with a brilliant knock of 136 runs off 207 balls, bringing up his 13th Test century shortly after lunch. He was supported by Devdutt Padikkal, who contributed 80 runs in a 165-run partnership, while Yashasvi Jaiswal added 85 runs on the second evening. Shubman Gill narrowly missed a century, getting bowled by Jacob Duffy for 98 runs just three balls before stumps. Rishabh Pant, with 55 not out, and Anshul Kamboj remained unbeaten at the close of play.

New Zealand's bowling attack struggled on a dry and lifeless pitch that provided minimal assistance. Kyle Jamieson took 1-57 for the home side, while Jacob Duffy finished the day conceding 1-180 in 29 overs. India's top five batters all scored over fifty runs as the visitors comfortably erased New Zealand's first-innings deficit. The two-match Test series is scheduled to conclude next week in Christchurch.

stories.title: National Bank of Pakistan Launches Advanced Digital Lab at Abbottabad School
stories.summary:
The National Bank of Pakistan (NBP) has successfully established an artificial intelligence, robotics, and STEM digital laboratory at Abbottabad Public School (APS). This initiative is designed to provide students with hands-on learning environments and direct access to modern technological facilities. 

The formal inauguration of the laboratory took place during the school's Annual Parents’ Day ceremony. The event was graced by Federal Minister for Education Wajiha Qamar, APS Principal Akhtar Ali Qureshi, and several other invited guests, as detailed in an official press release issued by the bank. 

The digital laboratory project was originally conceived and spearheaded by Farhan J. Durrani, the Divisional Head of NBP’s Digital Banking Group. The bank noted that the implementation of the facility involved coordinated institutional support, with NBP represented at the opening ceremony by Durrani, Islamabad and North General Manager Imran Gull, and Abbottabad Regional Head Fakhar Zaman Khan. 

Adnan Nasir, Chief Digital Officer of NBP’s Digital Banking Group, stated that the project underscores the bank's dedication to furnishing the upcoming generation with innovation and digital education. He noted that the lab will help prepare students for a future driven by technology through practical learning in emerging fields like artificial intelligence and robotics. 

NBP framed the venture as part of its broader corporate mission to contribute to the intellectual and technological growth of young individuals. This community investment initiative operates alongside the institution's core banking activities to foster advanced educational opportunities.

stories.title: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Governor Seeks Business Investment During Islamabad Chamber Visit
stories.summary:
Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Governor Faisal Karim Kundi recently invited the business community to invest heavily in the minerals, hydropower, and tourism sectors of his province. Speaking at the Islamabad Chamber of Commerce and Industry (ICCI), Kundi highlighted that KP also holds vast investment potential in agriculture, information technology, and industrial development. 

During his address, Governor Kundi stressed that strong public-private partnerships, consistent investor-friendly policies, and institutional coordination are vital to unlock the regional economic potential. He encouraged ICCI leaders and members to explore avenues for deeper commercial cooperation between Islamabad and KP, noting that lasting security is crucial for investor confidence. He affirmed that federal and provincial governments are fully committed to eliminating terrorism on a war footing. 

To foster institutional collaboration, Governor Kundi announced the appointment of a dedicated focal person at the Governor House to maintain close liaison with ICCI. He also promised a comprehensive investment briefing to showcase KP's high-potential sectors. Furthermore, he emphasized the provincial administration's commitment to addressing youth challenges through targeted education, skills development, and entrepreneurship opportunities. 

ICCI President Mohammad Zikria Akbar Zia responded by acknowledging the untapped economic potential of KP, suggesting joint business delegations and sector-specific interactions. He proposed establishing two focal persons—one in Peshawar and another at ICCI—to facilitate continuous communication. Additional ICCI officials, including Senior Vice President Mohammad Ashfaq Hussain Chatha and Vice President Mohammad Waqas Khan Swati, pointed out the benefits of improved infrastructure and simplified regulatory procedures. 

Chairman ICCI Founder Group Sheikh Tariq Sadiq also raised practical concerns regarding trade, particularly calling for the removal of transport hurdles for essential commodities like wheat and flour to ensure market stability and strong inter-provincial economic integration.

stories.title: Punjab Environment Protection Department Intensifies Crackdown on Non-Compliant Brick Kilns
stories.summary:
The Environment Protection Department Punjab has ramped up its provincial enforcement drive against environmentally non-compliant brick kilns to curb emissions and tackle severe smog. Between January 1 and November 18, 2026, the department conducted 84,370 visits across the province, resulting in the demolition of 1,429 units, the sealing of 968 kilns, and the registration of 1,248 First Information Reports (FIRs). 

During this ongoing enforcement campaign, authorities also collected Rs178 million in fines from violators. To ensure that compliance is sustained rather than temporary, the department utilizes a repeated-inspection mechanism. Field teams continually revisit previously checked brick kilns to monitor corrective measures, verify ongoing adherence to environmental regulations, and pursue additional legal action against recurring offenders. 

Enforcement efforts intensified further during the critical smog season spanning September 1 to November 18. In this specific timeframe, field personnel carried out 29,999 visits, leading to 519 demolitions, 494 closures, and 408 registered FIRs, alongside the imposition of Rs101.45 million in fines. The aggressive momentum continued into November, with teams logging 7,509 visits between November 1 and November 18, which yielded 101 demolitions, 161 sealed sites, 96 FIRs, and Rs27.6 million in financial penalties. 

Silwat Saeed, Secretary of the Environment Protection and Climate Change Department Punjab, underscored the necessity of sustained field enforcement and strict regulatory implementation. The department's overarching strategy centers on tackling pollution directly at its source, compelling brick-kiln operators to meet required environmental standards and ensuring that official interventions yield long-term ecological improvements.

stories.title: Court Extends Physical Remand of Police Officer's Wife and Qari Over Minor Maid's Death
stories.summary:
A local judicial magistrate in Islamabad has extended the physical remand of a senior police officer's wife and a religious teacher for an additional three days. The suspects are facing legal proceedings related to the alleged torture and subsequent death of a 13-year-old domestic worker named Fatima Asghar. 

Investigating Officer Nadeem Mughal produced the accused individuals, Afshan Bibi and Qari Ali, before Judicial Magistrate Naima Iffat following the expiration of their previous remand period. The case was initially registered against them at the Shams Colony Police Station. During the proceedings, the investigation officer requested a four-day extension to finalize the ongoing inquiry. 

Alongside the extension request, the investigating officer presented a USB drive containing CCTV footage allegedly showing the 13-year-old victim being subjected to physical abuse. The presiding judge directed the officer to place formal screenshots of the video evidence onto the official case record before reviewing the digital material. According to sources, the footage captures multiple incidents of the minor being assaulted by the two suspects on different occasions. 

The arrests followed the registration of a murder case invoking Section 302 of the Pakistan Penal Code. According to the initial FIR filed by the victim's father, the young girl was studying Hifz-ul-Quran at a local madrassa and residing with close relatives stationed at the Police Lines Headquarters located in Sector H-11, Islamabad.

stories.title: Alkhidmat Orphan Care Programme Honours Outstanding Matriculation Students in Karachi
stories.summary:
Alkhidmat's Orphan Care Programme hosted a special awards ceremony at its Karachi head office on Friday to celebrate orphan students who achieved exceptional results in their matriculation examinations. Clusters of students from across the city gathered to receive cash prizes, shields, and certificates recognizing their academic achievements. The top three achievers who earned A1 grades received cash prizes and certificates, while students with A grades were presented with shields and certificates, and those with B grades received certificates.

The event featured speeches from prominent organization figures, including Bano Qabil Program Director Farooq Kamlani, Community Services Director Umar Qaimkhani, and Senior Manager of the Orphan Care Program Salman Athar, alongside the students' mothers and guardians. Addressing the audience, Farooq Kamlani described matriculation as the critical initial step toward higher education and future professional opportunities. He advised mothers to support their children in pursuing fields that match their natural abilities and interests, noting that these youth represent the country's bright future leaders.

Umar Qaimkhani directed his remarks toward spiritual and personal development, reminding attendees that while worldly accomplishments are important, true success lies in the Hereafter through adherence to religious teachings. He also encouraged the youth to honor their parents and teachers, whose guidance remains vital throughout life. Alkhidmat continues to provide ongoing financial and social support to orphaned children while organizing these events to honor academic milestones.

This initiative matters because it highlights community efforts to uplift vulnerable students by providing tangible recognition and guidance for their future. Through continuous backing and motivational programs, organizations like Alkhidmat help bridge gaps for orphaned youth, ensuring they stay motivated to pursue higher education and meaningful careers despite socioeconomic challenges.

stories.title: Pakistan Business Leader Warns Import Growth Outpaces Exports and Widens Deficit
stories.summary:
Mian Zahid Hussain, president of the Pakistan Businessmen and Intellectuals Forum, has called for a detailed review of import growth by product category, noting that approximately 89 percent of the increase in imports between July and September came from non-petroleum categories. Machinery imports rose by roughly USD504.1 million, and metal imports grew by USD377.1 million, driven by expanding industrial activity. Meanwhile, higher global prices inflated the petroleum import bill despite lower overall volumes. He urged the government to assess economic returns from productive imports and bolster domestic manufacturing of industrial inputs to save foreign exchange.

Exporters continue to face multiple headwinds, including expensive electricity and gas, multiple taxes, delayed tax refunds, and heavy certification expenses. Longer shipping times have compounded working capital requirements and increased financing costs for businesses relying on commercial credit. Furthermore, regional conflicts such as the US-Iran war and closures of key shipping routes like the Strait of Hormuz and Bab el-Mandeb have severely disrupted logistics. Freight costs for a 40-foot dry container from Karachi to Qatar's Hamad Port surged to USD8,500–8,800, leading to a 6.4 percent decline in exports to GCC countries.

During the first four months of the fiscal year, from July to October, Pakistan's exports rose 8.52 percent to USD11.336 billion, while imports grew 12.59 percent to USD25.964 billion, widening the trade deficit by 15.97 percent to USD14.628 billion. Hussain pointed out that for every additional dollar earned through exports, the import bill increased by roughly USD3.26. October exports alone grew by a modest 2.84 percent year-on-year.

Addressing these macroeconomic imbalances is critical for Pakistan's long-term economic stability. Hussain urged coordinated efforts among the Ministry of Commerce, Ministry of Maritime Affairs, FBR, TDAP, and FPCCI to streamline logistics, ensure transparent freight rates, expedite tax refunds, and lower production costs to secure lasting reductions in the trade deficit.

stories.title: LSE Financial Services Launches AI-Enabled Order Management System for Brokers
stories.summary:
LSE Financial Services Limited (LSEFSL) has launched an artificial intelligence-enabled Order Management System (OMS) for Pakistan's brokerage industry, integrating it with its existing Smart Back Office System that currently serves 60 brokers. The company announced the development in a material information notice submitted to the Pakistan Stock Exchange (PSX) on Friday. This integration allows LSEFSL to provide a comprehensive stock market technology solution to online brokerage firms and industry participants, expanding its service offerings.

In addition to the OMS launch, LSEFSL confirmed plans to apply to the Pakistan Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority (PVARA) for a digital assets custodian licence. This move is intended to complement blockchain-based custody solutions currently being developed by its associated firm, Digital Custodian Company Limited. However, the company has not yet disclosed a specific timeline for submitting the licence application or deploying the new custody operations.

LSEFSL has a long corporate history, originating as Lahore Stock Exchange (Guarantee) Limited on October 5, 1970, before re-registering as a public unlisted company limited by shares in August 2012. Following the consolidation of Pakistan's stock exchanges in January 2016, it operated as an investment finance services company under an NBFC licence, which expired on January 11, 2025, and was intentionally not renewed. The company's shares began trading on the PSX on May 31, 2024, after transferring its listing status from Modaraba Al-Mali under a management arrangement with LSE Capital Limited.

This technological rollout matters because it introduces advanced AI tools to Pakistan's financial brokerage sector, potentially improving trading efficiency and back-office management. By expanding into digital asset custody and modern software systems, LSEFSL positions itself to adapt to evolving technological demands within the country's capital markets.

stories.title: Federal Minister Ahsan Iqbal Urges Integration of Religious and Modern Education
stories.summary:
Federal Minister for Planning, Development and Special Initiatives Ahsan Iqbal emphasized the necessity of merging religious and modern education, promoting scientific research, and equipping Madrasa students with contemporary skills. Speaking at a National Conference titled “The Role of Islamic Madaris in a Changing World” in Islamabad on Friday, Iqbal stated that Islam makes no separation between religious and worldly knowledge. He cited the historical contributions of Muslim scholars in Spain to science, mathematics, and astronomy, while noting that colonial-era policies and historical divisions created an artificial gap between educational systems.

Organized by Jamiat Talaba Arabia Pakistan, the conference addressed various challenges faced by Madrasa graduates, including access to higher education, professional opportunities, and official recognition of academic qualifications. Representative groups highlighted hurdles related to English-language examination requirements, which the Minister assured participants would be taken up with relevant authorities. Furthermore, Iqbal outlined the establishment of nine Seerat Chairs aimed at tackling contemporary issues such as women's empowerment, interfaith harmony, and water conservation.

The Minister stressed that a truly inclusive education framework must combine Islamic ethics, modern sciences, and critical thinking, while also emphasizing the cognitive benefits of mother-tongue education. He cautioned against extremism, misinformation, and terrorism, calling instead for national unity, constructive dialogue, and comprehensive educational reforms.

This initiative is significant because it addresses systemic educational divides in Pakistan, seeking to empower Madrasa students to contribute effectively to the nation's socio-economic development. By fostering scientific inquiry alongside traditional scholarship, the government aims to enhance the employability and national integration of religious seminary graduates.

stories.title: Fire at Basra Power Station in Iraq Kills Four and Injures Thirty
stories.summary:
At least four people were killed and 30 others injured following a fire that broke out at a power station in southern Iraq on Saturday. Security officials reported that the death toll from the incident is expected to rise as investigations and rescue efforts continue.

The blaze occurred at the Hartha power station, situated north of Basra. Civil defence teams managed to bring the fire under control after firefighters responded to the scene, according to Iraq's state news agency, INA. Security officials confirmed that the fire spread to neighboring residential houses and forced the complete suspension of operations at the power facility.

Prior to the incident, the Hartha station was operating at approximately 400 megawatts, despite having an installed generating capacity of 800 megawatts. State news reported that there was no immediate official information regarding the underlying cause of the fire or the precise extent of the property damage caused.

Iraq's broader electricity infrastructure has long suffered from decades of underinvestment, inadequate maintenance, and a continuous inability to meet peak electricity demands, particularly during severe summer heatwaves. Past technical failures and fires at various power facilities and substations have frequently triggered widespread power outages and disrupted electricity supplies across the country.

stories.title: یوکرین کے صدر زیلنسکی کا روسی صدر کو ’قاتل‘ قرار دینے کا سخت بیان
stories.summary:
یوکرین کے صدر ولودیمیر زیلنسکی نے روسی صدر ولادیمیر پوٹن کو سخت تنقید کا نشانہ بناتے ہوئے انہیں ’قاتل‘ قرار دیا ہے۔ ان کا یہ بیان امریکی صدر ڈونلڈ ٹرمپ کی جانب سے روسی رہنما کو دوست قرار دیے جانے کے بعد سامنے آیا ہے، جس سے روس کے حوالے سے یوکرین اور امریکہ کے مؤقف میں پایا جانے والا واضح فرق ایک بار پھر اجاگر ہوا ہے۔

صدر زیلنسکی کا مؤقف ہے کہ یوکرین میں جاری جنگ، شہریوں کی ہلاکتوں اور بڑے پیمانے پر ہونے والی تباہی کے ذمہ داران کے ساتھ دوستانہ رویہ اختیار کرنے کے بجائے انہیں جوابدہ بنایا جانا چاہیے۔ انہوں نے کہا کہ امریکی صدر اپنی مرضی سے کسی کو بھی دوست کہہ سکتے ہیں، لیکن یوکرین کی نگاہ میں روسی صدر دشمن اور قاتل ہیں۔ ان کے مطابق، پوٹن کے ساتھ دوستانہ انداز اپنانے سے روسی قیادت پر جنگ بند کرنے کا دباؤ کم ہو سکتا ہے اور اسے مزید حملے جاری رکھنے کا حوصلہ مل سکتا ہے۔

دوسری جانب امریکی صدر ڈونلڈ ٹرمپ نے روسی صدر کے ساتھ اپنے اچھے تعلقات کا دفاع کرتے ہوئے کہا ہے کہ ماسکو کے ساتھ بہترین تعلقات ہونا ایک مثبت بات ہے اور اس سے عالمی معاملات میں امریکہ کی پوزیشن مزید مضبوط ہوتی ہے۔ انہوں نے اس عزم کا اظہار کیا کہ وہ ایک حقیقی معاہدہ چاہتے ہیں کوئی مصنوعی یا نمائشی سمجھوتہ نہیں۔

اس تناظر میں بین الاقوامی سطح پر مختلف سفارتی اور سلامتی کے امور بھی زیرِ بحث رہے ہیں، جن میں یوکرین کے امن مذاکرات میں یورپ کا مکمل کردار ادا کرنے کا مطالبہ، فرانس کا ماسکو جانے پر آمادگی کا اظہار، ڈنمارک کی جانب سے روسی دفاعی اہلکار کی ملک بدری، پیرو میں زلزلے کا واقعہ، اور تہران کے ساتھ جاری کشیدگی کے درمیان امریکی وزیر خزانہ کے فوجی اڈے پر مقیم ہونے کی اطلاعات شامل ہیں۔

stories.title: بلوچستان میں ریلوے ٹریک کی مرمت کے باعث ٹرین آپریشن معطل
stories.summary:
بلوچستان میں ریلوے حکام کی جانب سے جاری کردہ ہدایات کے مطابق مرمتی کام کے باعث آج ٹرین آپریشن مکمل طور پر معطل رہے گا۔ ریلوے انتظامیہ نے واضح کیا ہے کہ پشاور کے لیے روانہ ہونے والی جعفر ایکسپریس آج سفر کا آغاز نہیں کرے گی جبکہ جناح پیپلز ٹرین کی سروس بھی معطل رکھی گئی ہے۔ اس کے علاوہ، پشاور سے کوئٹہ آنے والی جعفر ایکسپریس کے سفر کو محدود کرتے ہوئے اسے صرف جیکب آباد تک ہی چلایا گیا ہے۔

دوسری جانب ملک بھر کے مختلف سیاسی اور انتظامی امور پر بھی اہم پیشرفت سامنے آئی ہے۔ اسلام آباد میں پریس کانفرنس کے دوران وزیر قانون اعظم نذیر تارڑ نے بتایا کہ حکومت کی جانب سے پچیس وفاقی اداروں کی کارکردگی کا جائزہ لیا گیا ہے۔ وفاقی وزیر مصدق ملک نے خطے کی ترقی کے لیے ثقافتی روابط کو ناگزیر قرار دیا جبکہ پاکستان تحریک انصاف کے رہنما علی محمد خان نے بلاول بھٹو اور محسن نقوی کے بیانات پر ردعمل کا اظہار کیا۔ وزیر دفاع خواجہ آصف نے بھی نئے صوبوں کے قیام کے حوالے سے اپنے خیالات کا اظہار کیا۔

صوبہ خیبر پختونخوا کے ضلع کوہاٹ میں سکیورٹی فورسز نے ایک کارروائی کے دوران فتنہ الخوارج کے تین دہشت گردوں کو ہلاک کر دیا جبکہ اس دوران ان کے چند ساتھی موقع سے فرار ہونے میں کامیاب ہو گئے۔ محکمہ پولیس کے مطابق گرفتار افراد میں جھنگ کا رہائشی ظہیر خان بھی شامل ہے، جبکہ دیگر قانونی کارروائیوں کا سلسلہ جاری ہے۔ اس کارروائی کے تناظر میں صوبائی حکومت کی جانب سے متعدد اہم فیصلے کیے گئے ہیں۔

تعلیمی شعبے میں بہتری لانے کے لیے خیبر پختونخوا کے تمام سرکاری پرائمری اسکولوں میں روزانہ کی بنیاد پر ایک گھنٹہ ریڈنگ کے لیے لازمی قرار دے دیا گیا ہے۔ مزید برآں، صوبے کے مخصوص اضلاع میں غیر حاضر رہنے والے ہیلتھ اسٹاف کے خلاف بھی سخت کارروائی کرنے کا فیصلہ کیا گیا ہے۔ ان تمام اقدامات کا مقصد متعلقہ شعبوں میں نظم و ضبط کو بہتر بنانا اور عوامی خدمات کے معیار کو بلند کرنا ہے۔

stories.title: امریکی وفاقی تحقیقاتی ادارے کے مجرمانہ ڈیٹا بیس پر دوسرا سائبر حملہ
stories.summary:
امریکی وفاقی تحقیقاتی ادارے یعنی ایف بی آئی کے قومی مجرمانہ معلومات کے ڈیٹا بیس پر سائبر حملے کا ایک اور واقعہ پیش آیا ہے، جس کے بعد اس حساس نظام کے تحفظ پر سنجیدہ سوالات اٹھ کھڑے ہوئے ہیں۔ نیشنل کرائم انفارمیشن سینٹر کا یہ مرکزی ڈیٹا بیس امریکا بھر کے پولیس اور دیگر قانون نافذ کرنے والے اداروں کے لیے انتہائی اہمیت کا حامل ہے۔ اس سسٹم میں مطلوب افراد، گرفتاریوں کے ریکارڈ، لاپتہ افراد، چوری شدہ گاڑیوں، اسلحے اور دیگر انتہائی حساس مجرمانہ معلومات کا وسیع ڈیٹا محفوظ ہوتا ہے۔

چند ماہ کے دوران ایف بی آئی کے نظام پر یہ دوسرا مبینہ سائبر حملہ ہے، جس نے وفاقی، ریاستی اور مقامی پولیس اداروں کے درمیان مجرمانہ معلومات کے تبادلے کے اس اہم مرکز کی سکیورٹی کو خطرے میں ڈال دیا ہے۔ امریکی میڈیا رپورٹس کے مطابق ہیکرز کی جانب سے اس مرکزی ڈیٹا بیس تک رسائی حاصل کرنے کی کوشش کی گئی ہے تاکہ حساس نوعیت کے ریکارڈ کو نشانہ بنایا جا سکے۔

حالیہ دنوں میں اس ممکنہ سکیورٹی خلاف ورزی اور مداخلت کا علم ہونے کے بعد ایف بی آئی نے فوری طور پر اس واقعے کی باضابطہ تحقیقات کا آغاز کر دیا ہے۔ تحقیقات کا مقصد اس بات کا تعین کرنا ہے کہ اس سائبر حملے کے پیچھے کون تھا اور اس سے کتنی معلومات تک رسائی حاصل کی گئی ہے۔

یہ دوسرا واقعہ ایسے وقت میں سامنے آیا ہے جب قانون نافذ کرنے والے اداروں کے ڈیٹابیس کی سائبر سکیورٹی پہلے ہی انتہائی تشویشناک سمجھی جاتی ہے۔ اس تازہ ترین واقعے سے امریکی سکیورٹی اداروں کی ڈیجیٹل کمزوریوں اور حساس مجرمانہ ریکارڈ کی حفاظت پر سنگین خدشات ظاہر کیے جا رہے ہیں۔

stories.title: کراچی ائرپورٹ پر مولانا فضل الرحمٰن کے چھوٹے بھائی کو روک لیا گیا
stories.summary:
جمعیت علمائے اسلام (جے یو آئی) کے سربراہ مولانا فضل الرحمٰن کے چھوٹے بھائی ضیاء الرحمٰن کو کراچی ائرپورٹ پر امیگریشن حکام نے باہر جانے سے روک دیا۔ وہ سعودی عرب سے رات گئے پرواز کے ذریعے کراچی پہنچے تھے اور ان کے ہمراہ جے یو آئی سندھ کے جنرل سیکریٹری راشد محمود سومرو بھی موجود تھے۔

ضیاء الرحمٰن کی آمد کے موقع پر راشد محمود سومرو درجنوں پارٹی کارکنان کے ہمراہ ان کے استقبال کے لیے انٹرنیشنل آرائیول کے باہر موجود اور منتظر تھے۔ ائرپورٹ پر موجود امیگریشن حکام نے ضیاء الرحمٰن کو روکنے کے بعد وزارت داخلہ کو بذریعہ ای میل اس صورتحال سے آگاہ کیا۔

وزارت داخلہ کو ای میل بھیجنے کے بعد اسلام آباد سے باضابطہ جواب طلب کیا گیا تاکہ آگے کا لائحہ عمل طے کیا جا سکے۔ ذرائع کے مطابق اسلام آباد سے متعلقہ حکام کی جانب سے ضروری کارروائی اور جواب موصول ہونے کے بعد ہی ضیاء الرحمٰن کو وہاں سے جانے کی اجازت دی گئی۔

یہ واقعہ کراچی ائرپورٹ کے انٹرنیشنل آرائیول پر پیش آیا جہاں پارٹی رہنماؤں اور کارکنان کی بڑی تعداد موجود تھی۔ حکام کی جانب سے بروقت رابطے اور منظوری کے بعد اس معاملے کو نمٹا لیا گیا اور ضیاء الرحمٰن کو روانہ ہونے دیا گیا۔

stories.title: یوکرین جنگ کے خاتمے کے لیے فرانس کا ماسکو جانے پر آمادگی کا اظہار
stories.summary:
فرانس نے اعلان کیا ہے کہ اگر یوکرین جنگ کے خاتمے کے لیے ہونے والے مذاکرات میں یورپی ممالک کو مکمل کردار دیا جائے تو وہ ماسکو کا دورہ کرنے کے لیے تیار ہیں۔ یہ پیش رفت روسی صدر ولادیمیر پیوٹن کی جانب سے یورپی رہنماؤں کو مذاکرات کی غرض سے ماسکو آنے کی دعوت دینے کے بعد سامنے آئی ہے۔ چینی شہر شینزن میں امریکی صدر ڈونلڈ ٹرمپ، روسی صدر ولادیمیر پیوٹن اور چینی شی جن پنگ کی غیر معمولی ملاقات کے بعد سفارتی سرگرمیوں میں تیزی آئی ہے۔ فرانسیسی صدر کے مشیر نے اس پیشکش کو مثبت قرار دیتے ہوئے کہا کہ یورپ یہ یقینی بنانا چاہتا ہے کہ اس کا مؤقف یوکرین اور امریکا کے مؤقف کے ساتھ مکمل طور پر ہم آہنگ ہو۔

دوسری جانب یوکرینی صدر ولودیمیر زیلنسکی نے برلن کے دورے کے دوران یورپی رہنماؤں کے ماسکو جانے کے فیصلے کو غلطی قرار دیا، تاہم انہوں نے اس بات پر زور دیا کہ تیسرے ممالک میں ہونے والے مذاکرات میں یورپ کی شمولیت لازمی ہونی چاہیے۔ دریں اثنا، یوکرین میں روسی فوج کی جانب سے میزائلوں اور ڈرونز کے حملے جاری رہے جن میں کیف، لویو، زاپوریژیا اور خارکیف کے علاقے شدید متاثر ہوئے۔ دارالحکومت کیف میں حملوں کے نتیجے میں کم از کم تین افراد ہلاک اور پندرہ زخمی ہوئے، جبکہ بجلی کا نظام اور دریائے دنیپرو پر قائم تین پل بھی متاثر ہوئے۔ لویو میں مسافر ٹرین اسٹیشن پر حملے سے دو افراد جان کی بازی ہار گئے۔

روسی حکام نے ان کارروائیوں کو بڑے پیمانے کی کارروائی قرار دیتے ہوئے تصدیق کی کہ فوجی صنعتی مراکز اور نقل و حمل کے بنیادی ڈھانچے کو نشانہ بنایا گیا ہے۔ چین میں ملاقات کے بعد روسی صدر پیوٹن نے خبردار کیا تھا کہ کریمیا کے پل پر حملے کا جواب اب زیادہ تکلیف دہ ہوگا۔ دوسری جانب امریکی صدر ڈونلڈ ٹرمپ نے وائٹ ہاؤس میں گفتگو کرتے ہوئے کہا کہ پیوٹن سفارتی طریقے سے جنگ کا خاتمہ چاہتے ہیں اور فریقین کے درمیان معاہدہ طے پانے کا حقیقی موقع موجود ہے، تاہم ان کے درمیان موجود شدید اختلافات اصل رکاوٹ ہیں۔

stories.title: تنقید سے دلبرداشتہ ہو کر وینا ملک نے لائیو شو میں میک اپ اتار دیا
stories.summary:
پاکستانی اداکارہ اور میزبان وینا ملک نے اپنے مارننگ شو ’وینا ہے نا‘ کے دوران انتہائی جذباتی انداز اختیار کرتے ہوئے لائیو ٹی وی پر اپنا میک اپ اتار دیا، جس کی ویڈیو سوشل میڈیا پر تیزی سے وائرل ہو گئی۔ نجی نیوز چینل کے اس شو کے ذریعے ٹی وی اسکرین پر واپسی کرنے والی اداکارہ کو ان کے وزن اور جسمانی ساخت کی وجہ سے سوشل میڈیا صارفین کی شدید تنقید کا سامنا کرنا پڑ رہا تھا۔

تنقید کا لائیو شو میں منہ توڑ جواب دیتے ہوئے وینا ملک نے پہلے اپنی ہیلز اتاریں اور ناظرین کو مخاطب کرتے ہوئے کہا کہ اگر لوگوں نے ان کا وزن دیکھ لیا ہے تو اب ان کا قد بھی دیکھ لیں۔ اس کے بعد انہوں نے لائیو کیمرے کے سامنے اپنا میک اپ بھی صاف کر دیا اور کہا کہ اب اگر کسی کو انہیں موٹا، سانولا یا بدصورت کہنا ہے تو وہ کہہ سکتا ہے، یہاں تک کہ ان کی اصل شکل پر بھی بریکنگ نیوز چلا دی جائے۔

اداکارہ نے واضح کیا کہ انہیں عوام کی جانب سے کیے جانے والے منفی تبصروں اور تنقید سے ذرا برابر بھی فرق نہیں پڑتا اور وہ تمام صورتحال میں مکمل اعتماد کے ساتھ کھڑی رہیں گی۔ ان کے اس نڈر اور منفرد اقدام کے بعد سوشل میڈیا پر متعدد صارفین نے ان کی حمایت کی اور ان کے اس بھرپور اعتماد کو سراہا۔

stories.title: رونالڈو کا 986واں گول، النصر کو الاہلی کے ہاتھوں شکست
stories.summary:
سعودی پرو لیگ میں کھیلے گئے ایک میچ کے دوران کرسٹیانو رونالڈو کی ٹیم النصر کو الاہلی کے ہاتھوں تین کے مقابلے میں ایک گول سے شکست کا سامنا کرنا پڑا۔ میچ کے 14ویں منٹ میں 41 سالہ پرتگالی اسٹار کرسٹیانو رونالڈو نے گول اسکور کر کے اپنی ٹیم کو برتری دلائی، جو ان کے کیریئر کا مجموعی طور پر 986واں گول تھا۔ اس طرح وہ اپنے تاریخی ایک ہزار گولز کے سنگ میل سے صرف 14 قدم کی دوری پر رہ گئے ہیں۔

تاہم، یہ میچ رونالڈو کے لیے تلخ یاد بن گیا کیونکہ گول کرنے کے صرف چار منٹ بعد انہیں پنالٹی کک پر گول کرنے کا موقع ملا، لیکن ان کا شاٹ گول پوسٹ سے ٹکرا کر واپس آ گیا۔ اس ناکامی کے ساتھ ہی وہ سعودی لیگ میں النصر کی نمائندگی کرتے ہوئے مسلسل دو لیگ میچوں میں پنالٹی ضائع کرنے والے ایک ناپسندیدہ ریکارڈ کا حصہ بن گئے۔

دوسری جانب، الاہلی کی طرف سے شاندار کارکردگی کا مظاہرہ کیا گیا۔ پہلے ہاف کے اضافی وقت میں گیلینو نے گول کر کے میچ برابر کیا، جبکہ دوسرے ہاف میں ایوان ٹونی نے پنالٹی پر گول کر کے اپنی ٹیم کو برتری دلائی۔ اس کے علاوہ راجر ایبانیز نے کارنر پر ہیڈر کے ذریعے تیسرا گول کر کے الاہلی کی فتح کو مکمل کیا۔

اس شکست کے نتیجے میں النصر کی ٹیم 28 پوائنٹس کے ساتھ پوائنٹس ٹیبل پر تیسرے نمبر پر آ گئی ہے، جبکہ الاہلی 24 پوائنٹس کے ساتھ چوتھے نمبر پر موجود ہے۔ النصر کا اگلا مقابلہ اب 28 نومبر کو الحزم کے خلاف شیڈول ہے۔ یہ میچ رونالڈو کے لیے ذاتی سنگ میل کے قریب پہنچنے کے باوجود مایوس کن ثابت ہوا۔

stories.title: امریکی وزیر خزانہ اسکاٹ بیسنٹ کا فوجی اڈے پر مقیم رہنے کا اعلان
stories.summary:
امریکہ کے وزیر خزانہ اسکاٹ بیسنٹ نے انکشاف کیا ہے کہ ایران کی جانب سے ملنے والی دھمکیوں کے بعد وہ اب بھی ایک امریکی فوجی اڈے پر رہائش پذیر ہیں۔ تاہم، انہوں نے تہران کے خلاف معاشی دباؤ کی پالیسی کو سختی کے ساتھ جاری رکھنے کا پختہ عزم ظاہر کیا ہے۔

غیر ملکی خبر رساں ادارے رائٹرز کے مطابق، اسکاٹ بیسنٹ نے ایک امریکی ٹی وی چینل سی این بی سی کو انٹرویو دیتے ہوئے کہا کہ اگر ایرانی حکام انہیں نشانہ بنانا چاہتے ہیں، تو اس کا سیدھا مطلب یہ ہے کہ امریکہ کی جانب سے ڈالا جانے والا معاشی دباؤ انتہائی مؤثر ثابت ہو رہا ہے۔ انہوں نے مزید کہا کہ اگر ایرانی ان کے پیچھے ہیں تو وہ یہ دباؤ مزید جاری رکھیں گے۔

محکمہ خزانہ کے مطابق، اسکاٹ بیسنٹ سکیورٹی خدشات کے پیش نظر فوجی اڈے پر مقیم ہیں، البتہ ایران کی جانب سے ملنے والی مبینہ دھمکیوں کی مخصوص نوعیت اور تفصیلات کو پبلک نہیں کیا گیا۔ امریکی محکمہ خزانہ حالیہ مہینوں میں ایران کے خلاف پابندیوں اور معاشی اقدامات کو مزید سخت کر رہا ہے تاکہ تہران کے مالی اور تجارتی ذرائع کو محدود کیا جا سکے۔

یہ صورتحال فروری میں امریکہ اور اسرائیل کی جانب سے ایران پر کیے گئے حملوں کے بعد پیدا ہونے والے تنازع اور خطے میں جاری کشیدگی کے پس منظر میں سامنے آئی ہے۔ اس کے باوجود، اس تنازع کے حل کے لیے سفارتی سطح پر رابطے اب بھی جاری رکھے گئے ہیں۔

stories.title: ایس آئی ایف سی کا فارماسیوٹیکل میں خودکفالت اور برآمدات بڑھانے پر زور
stories.summary:
اسپیشل انویسٹمنٹ فیسلٹی کونسل (ایس آئی ایف سی) کے تحت ملک کے فارماسیوٹیکل شعبے کو خودکفাত بنانے اور برآمدات کو فروغ دینے کے لیے مؤثر اقدامات کا آغاز کر دیا گیا ہے۔ اس سلسلے میں ایک اعلیٰ سطحی اجلاس وفاقی وزیرِ صحت مصطفیٰ کمال اور نیشنل کوآرڈینیٹر کی مشترکہ زیرِ صدارت منعقد ہوا۔

اجلاس کے دوران پاکستان کے شعبۂ صحت اور فارماسیوٹیکل انڈسٹری میں بہتری لانے اور اسے مالی طور پر مستحکم کرنے کے لیے متعدد اہم امور پر تفصیلی تبادلہ خیال کیا گیا۔ شرکاء نے مقامی سطح پر ویکسین کی تیاری کے لیے ایک موثر لائحہ عمل تیار کرنے پر غور کیا تاکہ اس شعبے میں ملکی خودکفالت کو یقینی بنایا جا سکے۔

اس کے علاوہ اجلاس میں مستحق مریضوں کے خصوصی علاج کے لیے شفاف منظوری کے طریقہ کار کا بھی جائزہ لیا گیا۔ ادویات کی قیمتوں کے درست تعین اور بین الاقوامی منڈی میں ملکی فارماسیوٹیکل مصنوعات کی برآمدات کو بڑھانے کی غرض سے 'فارما ایکسپورٹ کونسل' کے قیام پر بھی تفصیلی گفتگو کی گئی۔

ایس آئی ایف سی ملک میں ویکسین کی مقامی پیداوار کے ذریعے خودکفالت حاصل کرنے کے ساتھ ساتھ پاکستانی فارماسیوٹیکل انڈسٹری کی عالمی سطح پر برآمدات کو فروغ دینے کے لیے مکمل طور پر پرعزم نظر آتی ہے۔

stories.title: Iran Urges Global Remembrance for 168 Killed in School Airstrikes
stories.summary:
Iran's mission to the United Nations called upon the international community to honor the children and teachers killed during US airstrikes on a school in Minab. Speaking on World Children's Day via social media platform X, the mission stated that 168 children and teachers died in the two strikes on February 28, which marked the beginning of the ongoing US military campaign.

The statement also drew attention to approximately 300 surviving students who continue to experience severe psychological trauma and require long-term care and support. A recent UN-backed fact-finding mission indicated reasonable grounds to conclude that the US committed war crimes through these Tomahawk airstrikes. While US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth previously noted that the Pentagon was investigating the incident, details regarding accountability remain undisclosed.

Concurrently, the US Treasury Department announced new sanctions against Iranian oil traders and government-linked facilitators under Operation Economic Outcast. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent accused Tehran of prioritizing regime interests over citizens facing shortages, while the State Department alleged that individuals like Mohammad Javad Bavand and Majid Taj illicitly sold oil to fund military activities and terrorism.

These developments underscore the deep humanitarian and geopolitical tensions stemming from the ongoing conflict. Highlighting the Minab tragedy and implementing strict financial sanctions reflect the opposing positions and ongoing hostilities between Washington and Tehran.

stories.title: Lahore High Court Restricts Federal Bureau of Revenue From Unregistered Sales Tax Collection
stories.summary:
The Lahore High Court in Lahore has ruled that the Federal Bureau of Revenue must formally register businessmen prior to initiating sales tax collection. Justice Muhammad Ajmal Zahid delivered the decision, establishing that provision 3 of the Sales Tax Act applies strictly after a business person completes registration. Consequently, the court prohibited the department from independently collecting sales tax without following the correct legal sequence for registration and subsequent tax recovery.

During the proceedings, the court dismissed all four tax references brought forward by Inland Revenue regarding sales tax, while upholding the March 15, 2022 decision issued by the Tribunal. Additionally, the judiciary nullified the ghee and cooking oil supply case covering the period from 2016 to 2019.

This legal clarification matters because it establishes clear procedural boundaries for tax authorities, protecting businesses from arbitrary revenue collection practices. By mandating registration as a prerequisite, the ruling ensures that the department follows proper legal protocols before determining and recovering financial obligations from taxpayers.

The background of the case involves prolonged disputes over tax applicability on edible oil supplies from several years ago. The court's definitive stance reinforces statutory compliance within tax administration, requiring authorities to respect established legislative frameworks when dealing with the business community.

stories.title: Army Chief Praises Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Police During North Waziristan Tour
stories.summary:
Field Marshal Syed Asim Munir, holding the roles of Chief of Army Staff and Chief of Defence Forces, praised the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Police as a brave frontline force during a visit to Miran Shah in the North Waziristan District. The Inter-Services Public Relations released a statement in Rawalpindi on Friday detailing the visit, where the military leader highlighted the resilience and sacrifices demonstrated by the police force in the face of terrorism and Fitna al-Khwarij.

Upon arriving in the region, the Chief of Army Staff and Chief of Defence Forces placed a floral wreath at Yadgar-e-Shuhada to honor the ultimate sacrifices made by Pakistan Army martyrs. He subsequently received an in-depth briefing covering the regional security climate, ongoing intelligence-driven operations, and initiatives aimed at locking in gains from long-term counter-terrorism campaigns to secure lasting stability.

During the tour, the top commander engaged with military troops and officers, commending their high preparedness, professionalism, and dedication to defending the nation. He reiterated the firm commitment of security forces and law enforcement agencies to eradicate terrorism entirely and safeguard the stability achieved in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

The visit underscores ongoing military and civilian security cooperation in the region. The Commander Peshawar Corps greeted the Chief of Army Staff and Chief of Defence Forces upon his arrival in the district, marking another step in maintaining strategic coordination for regional peace.

stories.title: Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari Supports Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif Completing Full Five-Year Term
stories.summary:
Pakistan Peoples Party Chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari stated in Karachi on Friday that he wants Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif to become the first elected premier in the country's history to complete a five-year constitutional term. Speaking at an event, Bilawal pledged his backing for the prime minister to help navigate severe economic hardships, noting that he aimed to strengthen the premier's position rather than plot his downfall. No elected prime minister has finished a full five-year term since national independence in 1947.

Addressing broader economic issues, Bilawal remarked that financial conditions were exceptionally challenging and warned that the regional conflict involving Iran could worsen the situation, impacting household budgets and fertilizer supplies. He noted that inflation, poverty, and high utility bills were burdening citizens, while regretting that leaders had diverted attention from public hardships. He mentioned that while the economy avoided default, the prime minister lacked adequate opportunity to implement his economic agenda due to interference from certain federal ministers.

Turning to agricultural policy, Bilawal highlighted the Benazir Hari Card initiative designed to assist small landowners and farmers in Sindh who own up to 25 acres, providing financial aid of Rs4,000 per acre. He also noted relief efforts for disaster-hit Tharparkar and Umerkot districts through the Benazir Income Support Programme. He emphasized that supporting small farmers, who comprise 90 percent of the agricultural sector, remains a priority during economic turmoil.

On the political front, Bilawal stressed that no single party can resolve national crises alone, urging cooperation and dialogue. He acknowledged Jamiat Ulema-i-Islam-Fazl chief Maulana Fazlur Rehman as opposition and called for Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf to return to parliament. He argued that public welfare and basic needs, such as food and shelter, should take precedence over political vendettas or debates on creating new provinces.

stories.title: Federal Government Appoints Shagufta Shamsuddin Hassan as Securities and Exchange Policy Board Chairperson
stories.summary:
The federal government has named Ms Shagufta Shamsuddin Hassan as the new Chairperson of the Securities and Exchange Policy Board, effective immediately. The Finance Division, specifically through its Investment Wing, announced the appointment via notification No. F.3(15)Inv-II/2004.

This leadership change is executed under the legal authority granted by Section 12, subsection 7 of the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan Act, 1997. The legislation outlines the governance framework for the country's financial and corporate regulatory bodies.

The appointment matters because the policy board plays a crucial role in directing the regulatory oversight of Pakistan's capital markets, corporate sector, and financial services industry. Ms. Hassan will head the board to guide strategic policies implemented by the commission.

Background details regarding the transition are limited to the official notification issued by the Finance Division. The announcement marks an administrative update in the governance structure of the regulatory authority.

stories.title: World Bank Project Achieves 90 Percent Progress in Punjab Land Digitisation
stories.summary:
A land reform initiative in Punjab has reached 90 percent physical progress ahead of its scheduled completion date in June 2027. Funded by the World Bank, the Punjab Urban Land Systems Enhancement Project is implemented by the Punjab Board of Revenue and the Punjab Land Records Authority to upgrade land records and pinpoint public properties for housing and development.

According to official documentation, the project has successfully digitised and notified 5,805 out of the province's 6,014 revenue villages. Furthermore, about 69.9 million land rights have been registered or linked to the Land Records Management Information System, surpassing the original target of 50.68 million. Women comprise 31 percent of these registered rights, and digital cadastral maps now cover 86 percent of Punjab. Additionally, over 31 million person-based records have been converted into parcel-based records.

The project has also addressed jointly owned landholdings by partitioning roughly 28 percent of eligible cases and issuing thousands of Green Property Certificates. Public land screening has covered 933.5 hectares for housing initiatives, while 200 public land sites have been identified for development programs.

Originally approved on March 10, 2022, with a $150 million financing allocation later revised to $145.76 million, the project has disbursed approximately $90.08 million by October 2026. The World Bank maintains a moderate risk rating for the undertaking while upgrading its implementation and development objective ratings to highly satisfactory.

stories.title: Federal Board of Revenue Introduces Electronic Production Monitoring for Paper and Leather
stories.summary:
The Federal Board of Revenue has mandated electronic production monitoring for synthetic leather, paper, and paperboard sectors across Pakistan to combat tax evasion. Manufacturers must implement the prescribed monitoring systems at every facility by late November and mid-December 2026.

Under a notification issued on Friday, synthetic leather producers are required to acquire, install, integrate, and operationalize a monitoring system at each manufacturing plant and active roll-producing line by November 30, 2026. This setup will track production via sensor-based running-length measurement and video analytics at the final winding stage where finished rolls are cut and removed.

Similarly, Sales Tax General Order number 38 of 2026 directs all registered paper and paperboard manufacturers and toll manufacturers to install automated production monitoring by December 15, 2026. This hardware and software configuration will detect, weigh, and count stock-keeping units based on grade and grams per square meter using authorized vendor solutions.

Composite units and entities that utilize self-manufactured paper within the same premises must also integrate monitoring at the point where material is removed from the production line. Businesses solely engaged in cutting and printing are excluded from these specific requirements.

stories.title: Customs Values Revised for Imported Automotive and Motorcycle Bulbs
stories.summary:
The Directorate General of Customs Valuation has updated the customs values for imported motorcycle and automotive bulbs and components for the first time in nearly ten years. The revision follows findings that local market prices significantly exceeded figures previously recorded in import data.

Valuation Ruling No. 2131/2026, issued on Friday, establishes fresh customs valuations for various lighting products, including halogen headlights, LED, incandescent, high-intensity discharge, wedge, and festoon bulbs, alongside related parts like base caps and glass filaments. These new values will form the basis for assessing import duties and taxes, superseding the previous framework set by Valuation Ruling No. 865/2016 and subsequent updates from 2016 and 2019.

The directorate undertook the revision after examining 90 days of import data and conducting market surveys, which demonstrated a clear gap between declared import values and prevailing domestic prices. The updated schedule determines values based on product category, weight, and country of origin, encompassing items from China, Europe, Japan, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, and Korea.

Stakeholder consultations were conducted on September 15 and November 4, 2026, offering importers an opportunity to present supporting evidence for their declared values. Although written representations were submitted, stakeholders failed to provide the required sales tax invoices to substantiate their claims.

stories.title: Weather Forecast Across Major Cities in Pakistan
stories.summary:
Weather conditions across major cities in Pakistan feature varying temperature ranges for Friday, November 20, 2026, and forecasts for Saturday, November 21, 2026, according to the Business Recorder report. Karachi recorded a temperature high of 33 degrees Celsius and a low of 17 degrees Celsius on Friday, with Saturday expected to see a high of 33 degrees Celsius and a low of 16 degrees Celsius. Sunset in Karachi was logged at 5:43 PM on Friday, with sunrise scheduled for 6:51 AM on Saturday.

In Hyderabad, temperatures ranged from 32 to 18 degrees Celsius on Friday and are projected at 32 to 17 degrees Celsius for Saturday. Lahore experienced a high of 27 degrees Celsius and a low of 11 degrees Celsius, a range expected to repeat the following day. Larkana and Sukkur both reported identical conditions, with temperatures ranging between 30 and 14 degrees Celsius on Friday and 30 to 15 degrees Celsius on Saturday.

Mirpurkhas observed temperatures between 32 and 16 degrees Celsius, shifting slightly to 32 and 15 degrees Celsius on Saturday. Muzaffarabad recorded 23 to 9 degrees Celsius on Friday, moving to 22 to 10 degrees Celsius on Saturday. Peshawar noted 27 to 12 degrees Celsius on Friday, with a cooler high of 24 degrees Celsius expected on Saturday. Quetta remained the coolest location reported, maintaining consistent temperatures of 21 degrees Celsius during the day and 4 degrees Celsius at night across both dates. Rawalpindi registered 24 to 9 degrees Celsius on Friday, shifting to 23 to 10 degrees Celsius on Saturday.

stories.title: FPCCI Presidential Candidate Meets KCA Vice Chairman in Karachi
stories.summary:
Zubair Motiwala, the presidential candidate for the Federation of Pakistan Chambers of Commerce and Industry (FPCCI), recently traveled to Karachi alongside Javed Bilwani and Asif Baigah. The group met with Premchand Kohistani, who serves as the Vice Chairman of the Karachi Cotton Association (KCA), at his residence for a comprehensive dialogue concerning multiple challenges within the domestic economy.

The discussions primarily centered on the country's prevailing economic climate, the continuous decline in domestic cotton production, and specific difficulties affecting both the Karachi Cotton Association building and the Pakistan Cotton Ginners Association (PCGA). Additionally, the participants examined broader issues directly impacting the cotton and textile industries.

This meeting holds significant importance for the local business community as it sought to spotlight critical industry-related obstacles and underline the urgent need to fortify the nation's cotton value chain. Both sides used the platform to share perspectives on current financial pressures influencing industrial operations across Pakistan.

Background details highlighted the ongoing struggles within the agricultural and manufacturing sectors, particularly regarding cotton supply deficits. The gathering brought together key industrial figures to align their views on navigating macroeconomic hurdles and supporting the textile-driven economy.

stories.title: Sindh Assembly Debates Dalit Killings and Widespread Labor Violations
stories.summary:
The Sindh Assembly recently convened in Karachi to debate persistent labor law violations, minimum wage non-compliance, and the fatal shooting of two Hindu Dalits in Tharparkar. Opposition members strongly condemned the killings and demanded immediate arrests, noting that a protest sit-in led by Dr Khatumal and a senator had lasted for 40 hours without a response from the IG Sindh. Lawmaker Surendar Valasai reported that two people died and six others, including a woman, were sustained injuries in the incident.

During the session, Labour Minister Saeed Ghani acknowledged that labor laws were not fully enforced across the province. Opposition figures, including members from the MQM and PTI, criticized employers for forcing staff to work 12 to 16 hours for only eight hours of pay, while paying monthly salaries between Rs28,000 and Rs32,000 against the legally mandated minimum wage of Rs43,000. Minister Ghani stated that the department had conducted 9,755 inspections, identified violations at 574 locations, and secured 537 convictions, though he urged lawmakers to report specific offending institutions.

The assembly also addressed other critical issues, such as child labor affecting an estimated 1.3 million children in Sindh, workplace safety, and lagging worker registrations. Minister Ghani noted that 815,000 workers were registered by December 2025, with over 200,000 receiving Benazir Mazdoor Cards, while a digital Labour Inspection Management System is being developed with World Bank support to conclude by June or July 2027. Furthermore, discussions covered district vigilance committees, workers' healthcare facilities across various divisions, and the establishment of an independent endowment fund to assist victims of tragic incidents like the Valika Hospital case.

This debate matters because it exposes systemic gaps in labor welfare, wage protection, and worker safety enforcement across Sindh. It highlights the daily struggles of vulnerable laborers and pressures provincial authorities to improve administrative oversight, transparency, and accountability.

stories.title: IBA Karachi Hosts Fifth International Conference on Global Uncertainty
stories.summary:
The Institute of Business Administration (IBA) in Karachi recently hosted its fifth international conference titled “Transforming Business in the Age of Global Uncertainty” at its Main Campus. Organized by the School of Business Studies (SBS), the two-day event convened academics, policymakers, business leaders, and researchers to analyze effective responses to economic volatility, technological changes, and evolving global dynamics.

Dr. S Akbar Zaidi, the Executive Director of IBA Karachi, delivered the welcome remarks by addressing Pakistan's ongoing political and economic challenges. He warned that simply surviving repeated crises should not replace true, meaningful progress, urging for structural transformations that enhance the country's capability to thrive amid global disruptions. Following him, Dr. Abdullah Zafar Sheikh, the Dean of SBS and Conference Chair, spoke on the rising impact of artificial intelligence on education and employment, stressing that business schools must foster critical thinking and sound decision-making among future leaders.

The opening keynote address was presented by Prof. Marc Goergen, a finance professor from IE Business School in Madrid, Spain, who shared research on corporate governance and board structures. A subsequent panel discussion titled “From Exposure to Resilience: Transforming Pakistani Businesses in an Age of Global Uncertainty” was moderated by Ammar Habib Khan, CEO of the National Credit Guarantee Company Limited. The panel featured former finance ministers Asad Umar and Miftah Ismail, alongside Standard Chartered Pakistan CEO Adil Salahuddin and Meezan Bank Independent Director Nausheen Ahmad.

This conference is vital for the region as it provides a collaborative platform to evaluate strategic adaptations for businesses facing severe economic turbulence. By bringing together prominent financial minds and academic experts, the event addresses the urgent need for resilient corporate governance and innovative policy frameworks in Pakistan.

stories.title: Ministry's Proposed Jewellery Export Value Addition Changes Raise Concerns
stories.summary:
The Ministry of Commerce has proposed replacing percentage-based value-addition requirements for jewellery exports with fixed dollar rates per gram, sparking debate among industry observers and exporters. The new plan sets minimum value addition at USD 1.50 per gram for bangles and chains, USD 2 for other plain jewellery, and USD 4 for studded pieces. Currently, rules under SRO 760(I)/2013 enforce minimum thresholds of 8 percent, 12 percent, and 13 percent across these categories. The proposal has been forwarded to the Cabinet's Economic Coordination Committee (ECC) for approval.

Critics point out that the proposal lacks essential explanations regarding how these fixed dollar figures were calculated, how Customs will verify them, or whether calculations will use net or gross weights. Exporters previously complained that linking value-addition thresholds to fluctuating international gold prices increased their burden despite unchanging manufacturing processes. However, industry stakeholders and government bodies remain divided, with the Minister for Industries and Production favoring the retention of percentage-based rules instead of fixed rates.

Additional complications arise from tax concessions and import duty exemptions tied to these exports, as well as Pakistan's commitments under the IMF program to avoid new fiscal incentives and preferential tax treatment. Lowering mandatory value-addition could alter expected foreign exchange proceeds or the economic benefits of existing concessions, making a clear financial assessment necessary before implementation. Furthermore, critics note that labor costs and craftsmanship vary significantly across different products and producers, meaning a single official dollar amount may fail to reflect true commercial realities.

This issue matters because transparent export regulations are critical for maintaining predictable trade rules and safeguarding Pakistan's foreign exchange earnings. Without a public methodology detailing monitoring systems and fiscal impacts, the proposed reform risks creating greater confusion rather than the intended certainty for the jewellery export sector.

stories.title: امریکی صدر کے دورہ چین کے بعد حفاظتی اقدامات کے تحت صحافیوں کے فون ضبط
stories.summary:
امریکی صدر ڈونلڈ ٹرمپ کے ہمراہ چین کا دورہ کرنے والے صحافیوں کے موبائل فونز سکیورٹی خدشات کی بنیاد پر عارضی تحویل میں لے لیے گئے۔ امریکی میڈیا کی رپورٹس کے مطابق یہ احتیاطی قدم ممکنہ سائبر جاسوسی اور ڈیجیٹل نگرانی کے خطرات سے بچنے کے لیے اٹھایا گیا۔

واپس امریکا پہنچنے پر تمام متعلقہ صحافیوں کو ان کے موبائل فونز واپس کر دیے گئے۔ رپورٹس کے مطابق اس دورے کے اختتام پر صدر ٹرمپ کے طیارے ایئر فورس ون میں سوار صحافیوں کے فونز خصوصی حفاظتی بیگز میں رکھوائے گئے تھے۔ وائٹ ہاؤس کے عملے کے موبائل فونز کے حوالے سے بھی ڈیٹا مٹانے یا تلف کیے جانے کے خدشات کی اطلاعات سامنے آئی تھیں۔

اس عمل میں استعمال ہونے والے خصوصی حفاظتی بیگز کو 'فیراڈے بیگز' کہا جاتا ہے، جن میں فون رکھنے سے وائی فائی، موبائل نیٹ ورک اور تمام وائرلیس سگنلز کی ترسیل و وصولی بند ہو جاتی ہے۔ اس کے ذریعے فونز کو بیرونی رابطوں اور نیٹ ورکس سے مکمل طور پر الگ رکھا جاتا ہے۔

حکام نے واضح کیا ہے کہ یہ اقدام مکمل طور پر سکیورٹی کی غرض سے اٹھایا گیا احتیاطی قدم تھا۔ کسی بھی مخصوص جاسوسی کی کوشش یا صحافیوں کے آلات میں کسی بھی قسم کے نگرانی کے سافٹ ویئر کی موجودگی کی کوئی تصدیق نہیں کی گئی۔

stories.title: FBR Mandates Electronic Production Monitoring for Paper and Rexine Manufacturers
stories.summary:
The Federal Board of Revenue (FBR) in Islamabad has issued new orders making electronic production monitoring compulsory for manufacturers of paper, paperboard, and synthetic leather, commonly known as rexine. Industrial units are required to install the prescribed equipment within strict deadlines, with synthetic leather makers given until November 30 and paper and paperboard producers ordered to comply by December 15. Businesses are strictly prohibited from removing or supplying goods from their premises unless production has been properly recorded via the approved electronic monitoring systems.

Under Sales Tax General Order No. 38 of 2026, registered paper and paperboard manufacturers, including composite units and toll manufacturers, must implement systems that can detect, weigh, and count production according to stock keeping units, grades, and grammage. The regulations cover all paper manufacturing facilities but exclude businesses that only perform cutting and printing. The FBR authorized ISSM Labelling Solutions (Pvt) Ltd to provide these technical solutions and listed 45 registered businesses across tax offices in cities like Lahore, Karachi, and Peshawar, while instructing field staff to identify other applicable manufacturers.

Under Sales Tax General Order No. 39 of 2026, synthetic leather manufacturers must install electronic monitoring gear on every active roll producing line. This requirement applies to operations involving polyurethane, polyvinyl chloride, and other polymer-coated materials across coating, laminating, finishing, and cutting processes. The mandated technology utilizes electronic sensors and artificial intelligence video analytics to measure production length, track finished rolls, generate individual records with unique identification numbers, and maintain shift, daily, and monthly logs.

The regulatory push matters because it aims to tighten fiscal controls and curb tax evasion in key industrial sectors through automated surveillance. A key operational threshold dictates that any discrepancy exceeding 0.5 percent between recorded roll lengths and cumulative measurements will automatically trigger an alert system within the newly enforced framework.

stories.title: Punjab Sets Wheat Release Price and Enforces Strict Digital Monitoring
stories.summary:
The Punjab government has established the wheat release price at Rs4,500 per 40kg for flour mills and fixed the retail price for a 10kg bag of flour at Rs1,275. According to a notification issued by the Secretary of the Food Safety and Consumer Protection Department, the policy aims to stabilize the supply chain and manage rising wheat prices.

Under the new rules, wheat will be distributed to approved functional flour mills and registered atta chakkies upon advance payments verified by district food controllers (DFCs). The Directorate General of Food will allocate grain quotas based on population metrics, utilizing stocks from the Pakistan Agricultural Storage and Services Corporation, aggregators, and imported sources. Mills are required to maintain a strict extraction ratio of 70:18:12 for flour, fine flour, and bran respectively.

To guarantee transparency, the government has mandated digital monitoring and daily reporting. Mills must upload daily records of public and private wheat transactions, grinding activities, and sales onto the Food Department Inventory and Management System (FDIMS), alongside manual reports submitted to local DFCs.

These measures are designed to curb rising food inflation and ensure orderly distribution across districts. By enforcing rigorous tracking and fixed pricing, authorities aim to maintain market stability and protect consumers throughout the province.

stories.title: FCC Rules Provinces Cannot Assume Unexercised Federal Powers
stories.summary:
The Federal Constitutional Court (FCC) in Islamabad has delivered a landmark ruling establishing that parliament’s failure to exercise a specific fiscal power does not transfer that legislative subject to the provinces. Authored by Chief Justice Aminuddin Khan, the 59-page detailed judgement was issued by a two-judge bench that also included Justice Aamer Farooq. The ruling stems from 568 legal challenges filed by taxpayers against provincial infrastructure development cesses imposed by the governments of Sindh and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

In its verdict, the FCC allowed the civil appeals filed by taxpayers and set aside earlier contradictory judgements from the Sindh High Court and Peshawar High Court. The court declared the corresponding charging provisions, along with all associated rules, notifications, assessments, and recovery measures, unconstitutional and void of lawful authority. Furthermore, the bench ordered that no demands, surcharges, or penalties based entirely on those invalid charges could be enforced, and that any securities furnished solely for those charges must be discharged.

Addressing the constitutional parameters, the judgement clarified that the abolition of the Concurrent Legislative List through the 18th Amendment expanded provincial autonomy, but it did not transfer subjects expressly reserved for the federal domain. Chief Justice Khan noted that where a conflict arises with a competent federal law, Article 142 of the Constitution dictates that federal law prevails while conflicting provincial laws become void. However, the ruling explicitly affirmed that provinces retain the authority to enact constitutionally valid infrastructure or service charges on goods manufactured and consumed strictly within their own regional boundaries.

This judicial decision is significant because it curtails fiscal overreach by provincial authorities into matters related to imports, exports, and interprovincial trade. The court emphasized that a province's financial needs or its share under National Finance Commission arrangements do not supply missing legislative competence, and fiscal measures cannot be sustained as compensatory fees merely because goods utilize local infrastructure.

stories.title: Unesco Report Warns $35 Billion Annual Gap Threatens Early Education by 2030
stories.summary:
A newly released Unesco report highlights that ensuring every child receives at least one year of pre-primary education by 2030 will require more than $35 billion in additional annual funding worldwide. Published on World Children’s Day alongside Unicef and the OECD, the 2026 Global Report on Early Childhood Care and Education points out that global pre-primary enrolment rates have stalled over the past decade. Currently, only six in ten children entering primary school globally have attended at least one year of preschool, exposing persistent inequalities and growing financing gaps.

The report emphasizes that underinvestment carries a heavy economic price, estimating the global cost of inaction at an average of three percent of gross domestic product, which can rise to seven percent in low-income nations. Conversely, investing in early childhood education offers strong economic benefits, with estimates showing that every dollar invested in closing childcare policy gaps could generate $3.76 in additional global GDP by 2035. Early intervention is vital given that only 64 percent of children aged 24 to 59 months are developing as expected for their age globally, a figure that drops to 53 percent in sub-Saharan Africa.

Although early childhood education enrolment rose from 64 percent in 2003 to 75 percent in 2024, growth has largely plateaued since 2015. The data reveals stark regional divides: participation one year before primary entry exceeds 90 percent in Europe, Northern America, Latin America, and the Caribbean, whereas rates linger near 50 percent in Northern Africa, Western Asia, and sub-Saharan Africa. Government spending remains low in low- and middle-income countries, accounting for only three to four percent of education budgets on average.

To meet quality targets by 2030, low- and lower-middle-income countries must invest an average of $69 billion annually between 2027 and 2030. Because public financing is projected to cover only half of this requirement, an average annual financing gap of $35 billion remains, threatening the foundational learning and development of millions of children.

stories.title: PTI Chairman Barrister Gohar Demands Release of Detained Workers and Judicial Intervention
stories.summary:
Pakistan Tehreek-i-Insaf (PTI) Chairman Barrister Gohar Ali Khan has called for an immediate halt to injustices against detained party leaders and workers, urging the superior judiciary to intervene. Speaking at a press conference at the Peshawar Press Club alongside other party figures, he stated that PTI representatives had visited the families of recently arrested members to show solidarity. He noted that although the Peshawar High Court granted bail to several workers arrested under Section 3 of the Maintenance of Public Order, those individuals continue to face legal hurdles and are denied proper justice.

Barrister Gohar asserted that PTI and its supporters have endured four years of severe oppression and hardships while maintaining a peaceful political struggle. He emphasized that ordinary citizens exercising their right to speak out face mounting difficulties, and he urged authorities to stop applying discriminatory treatment against PTI members. He also addressed broader political security concerns, specifically criticizing reports about the withdrawal of state security for Jamiat Ulema-i-Islam-Fazl chief Maulana Fazlur Rehman and his family, warning that protecting all citizens is a fundamental state responsibility.

On the national political front, the PTI chairman advocated for unity and the formation of a broader political alliance to achieve stability. Regarding discussions about creating new provinces, he maintained that it was premature for his party to take a final stance, noting that PTI would consult its allies and party founder Imran Khan if a formal proposal emerges. Additionally, Barrister Gohar demanded the immediate return of reserved seats to PTI, asserting that those currently benefiting from the existing arrangement should relinquish them.

This press conference matters as it highlights ongoing political tensions and the opposition's persistent demands for institutional fairness, judicial independence, and constitutional rights in Pakistan. By pressing for the protection of detained activists and political dialogue, PTI continues to position itself against alleged state overreach while navigating legislative disputes.

stories.title: Sindh Chief Minister Announces Rs5.3 Billion Relief for Drought-Hit Villages
stories.summary:
Sindh Chief Minister Syed Murad Ali Shah has announced a Rs5.3 billion relief package aimed at drought-affected communities across 25 dehs in Tharparkar and Umerkot. The announcement was made during a ceremony inaugurated by PPP Chairman Bilawal Bhutto-Zardari to launch the Sindh Wheat Growers Support Programme 2026-27.

Under the relief package, eligible families residing in the drought-declared areas will receive financial assistance of Rs8,000 disbursed in three installments to help cover essential expenses such as flour and livestock fodder. The disbursements are scheduled to reach beneficiaries through the Benazir Income Support Programme payment mechanism, with the first installment arriving by December 1, the second by January 1, and the third by February 1.

During the same event, the chief minister highlighted the ongoing agricultural support initiatives designed to protect farmers from rising input costs and bolster food security. Eligible wheat growers holding up to 25 acres will receive a subsidy of Rs4,000 per acre to purchase DAP fertiliser, alongside an additional Rs2,000 per maund for wheat delivered directly to the government food department procurement system.

Mr Shah noted that the previous year's program successfully distributed approximately Rs41.84 billion to over 333,000 registered farmers via the Benazir Hari Card, contributing to a record wheat harvest of roughly 4.9 million tonnes. Additionally, the provincial government secured a wheat procurement price of Rs4,500 per maund for the current season to further incentivize growers and strengthen the rural economy.

stories.title: UN Talks on Lethal Autonomous Weapons Face Impasse in Geneva
stories.summary:
A United Nations conference discussing lethal autonomous weapons, often referred to as killer robots, encountered significant delays and an impasse in Geneva on Friday. The grueling five-day talks at the UN Review Conference of the Convention on Conventional Weapons faced roadblocks primarily due to opposition from Russia. Military forces worldwide are currently adopting artificial intelligence to accelerate target acquisition and boost operational precision, making discussions surrounding the governance of automated warfare increasingly urgent.

The 128 participating nations gathered to determine whether to initiate formal negotiations regarding the regulation of these systems, alongside the terms and duration of any potential oversight. Achieving a consensus among all member states proved difficult, as divisions emerged between nations favoring a legally binding agreement and technology-holding countries reluctant to accept restrictions. The United States proposed a five-year timeline for negotiations, whereas the International Committee of the Red Cross and various NGOs advocated for a one-year schedule. Furthermore, France promoted a hybrid strategy combining legally binding terms with non-binding rules.

Representatives from advocacy groups noted that a minority of states continued blocking progress during the final day of the conference, leaving the international majority to consider alternative methods for achieving weapons controls. The global coalition Stop Killer Robots reported that autonomous weapon systems have already undergone testing or deployment in conflicts such as the war in Ukraine. Additionally, procedural tensions arose on Monday when Russia objected to the inclusion of observers, including the European Union and civil society organizations, from participating in the discussions.

stories.title: کینیڈا کی برٹش کولمبیا کابینہ میں پاکستانی نژاد ذیشان واہلہ کی بطور وزیر مملکت تقرر
stories.summary:
کینیڈا کے صوبے برٹش کولمبیا کی نئی صوبائی کابینہ میں پاکستانی نژاد کینیڈین سیاست دان ذیشان واہلہ کو وزیر مملکت برائے ہاؤسنگ مقرر کر دیا گیا ہے۔ صوبے کے نو منتخب وزیرِ اعلیٰ لورن ڈورکسن نے اپنی نئی کابینہ کا اعلان کرتے ہوئے انہیں یہ اہم ذمہ داری سونپی ہے۔

صوبائی حکومت کی جانب سے جاری کردہ سرکاری فہرست کے مطابق ذیشان واہلہ ہاؤسنگ کے شعبے میں وزیر مملکت کے طور پر اپنی خدمات انجام دیں گے۔ اس شعبے کا مرکزی قلم دان وزیر کیتھی اون اسٹڈ کے پاس ہے، جبکہ ذیشان واہلہ اس کے تحت وزیرِ مملکت ہوں گے۔

لورن ڈورکسن نے برٹش کولمبیا کے 38ویں وزیرِ اعلیٰ کے طور پر حلف اٹھایا ہے۔ نئی کابینہ کی حلف برداری کی یہ تقریب صوبائی دارالحکومت وکٹوریہ کے گورنمنٹ ہاؤس میں منعقد ہوئی، جہاں دیگر وزرا نے بھی اپنے عہدوں کا حلف اٹھایا۔ اس نئی کابینہ میں دیگر جنوبی ایشیائی پس منظر کے سیاست دانوں کو بھی اہم عہدے ملے ہیں، جن میں جسی سہوتا کو وزیرِ عوامی تحفظ اور ہرمین بھنگو کو وزیر مملکت برائے محنت مقرر کیا گیا ہے۔

یہ تقرریاں 24 اکتوبر 2026 کو ہونے والے صوبائی انتخابات میں کنزرویٹو پارٹی کی اکثریت حاصل کرنے کے بعد عمل میں آئیں۔ برٹش کولمبیا کی کابینہ میں ذیشان واہلہ کی شمولیت کو کینیڈا کی پاکستانی نژاد کمیونٹی کے لیے ایک بڑی کامیابی اور حکومت میں جنوبی ایشیائی نمائندگی میں اضافے کے طور پر دیکھا جا رہا ہے۔

stories.title: جوش ہیزل ووڈ کا پیٹ کمنز کی غیر موجودگی میں آسٹریلوی ٹیم چھوڑنے کا عندیہ
stories.summary:
آسٹریلیا کے فاسٹ بولر جوش ہیزل ووڈ نے بال ٹیمپرنگ اسکینڈل کے معاملے پر کپتان پیٹ کمنز کا بھرپور دفاع کرتے ہوئے خبردار کیا ہے کہ اگر کمنز کو کپتانی سے ہٹایا گیا تو وہ بھی ٹیم میں اپنے مستقبل پر نظرثانی کرنے پر مجبور ہوں گے۔

نیউজ کارپ کو دیے گئے ایک انٹرویو میں ہیزل ووڈ نے 2018 کے دورہ جنوبی افریقا کے دوران پیش آنے والے بال ٹیمپرنگ واقعے سے متعلق اپنے پرانے مؤقف کو دہرایا۔ انہوں نے واضح کیا کہ انہیں سینڈ پیپر کے استعمال یا گیند کے ساتھ چھیڑ چھاڑ کرنے کے کسی بھی منصوبے کا کوئی علم نہیں تھا۔

ہیزل ووڈ کا کہنا تھا کہ حالیہ دنوں میں کچھ افراد کی جانب سے پیٹ کمنز کو بلاوجہ تنقید کا نشانہ بنایا جا رہا ہے، لیکن وہ اپنے کپتان کے ساتھ مضبوطی سے کھڑے ہیں۔ انہوں نے تعریف کی کہ کمنز نے گزشتہ پانچ سے چھ برسوں میں ٹیم کو بہترین طریقے سے متحد رکھا ہے تاکہ ماضی کا کوئی واقعہ دوبارہ نہ دہرایا جا سکے۔ انہوں نے دوٹوک الفاظ میں کہا کہ اگر پہلے ٹیسٹ میں کمنز کپتان نہیں ہوتے تو ان کے لیے یہ صورتحال ناقابل قبول ہوگی اور وہ خود بھی اپنے مستقبل کے بارے میں سوچیں گے۔

مزید برآں، ہیزل ووڈ نے کیمرون بینکرافٹ کے حالیہ بیان میں موجود تضادات کی نشاندہی کی۔ انہوں نے کہا کہ واقعے کے فورا بعد ہونے والی پوچھ گچھ میں انہوں نے اپنا موقف صاف کر دیا تھا، اور بینکرافٹ نے بھی کبھی واضح طور پر یہ نہیں کہا تھا کہ اس نے سینڈ پیپر استعمال کرنے کے بارے میں بولرز کو بتایا تھا۔ انہوں نے اسٹیو اسمتھ، ڈیوڈ وارنر اور بینکرافٹ پر عائد سزاؤں کو غیر معمولی قرار دیتے ہوئے بینکرافٹ کے ساتھ ہمدردی کا اظہار کیا۔

stories.title: بلوچستان کے نوجوانوں کے لیے وفاقی محکموں میں ملازمتوں اور روزگار کی فراہمی کا آغاز
stories.summary:
بلوچستان کے نوجوانوں کو روزگار کے مواقع فراہم کرنے کی غرض سے وفاقی حکومت اور عسکری قیادت کی کاوشیں رنگ لانے لگی ہیں، اور ملک کے وفاقی محکموں میں باقاعدہ بھرتیوں کا عمل شروع کر دیا گیا ہے۔ صوبے کے نوجوانوں نے اس اقدام کو ایک انتہائی احسن قدم قرار دیا ہے۔

بلوچستان سے تعلق رکھنے والے نوجوانوں نے وفاقی محکموں میں نئی بھرتیوں کے آغاز کا پرجوش خیرمقدم کیا ہے۔ ان کا کہنا ہے کہ وزیراعظم پاکستان، وزیرِ اعلیٰ بلوچستان اور عسکری قیادت کی مشترکہ کوششوں کے نتیجے میں اب بلوچستان کے عوام کو ان کے جائز حقوق مل رہے ہیں۔

نوجوانوں نے اس بات کا اظہار کیا کہ وفاقی محکموں میں اس طرح کی اسامیاں پیدا ہونا اور ان پر نوجوانوں کی شمولیت ایک انتہائی خوش آئند عمل ہے۔ انہیں پوری توقع ہے کہ نئی آسامیوں میں صوبے کے نوجوانوں کو ان کا مناسب حق اور بھرپور نمائندگی دی جائے گی تاکہ وہ قومی دھارے میں شامل ہو سکیں۔

متاثرہ نوجوانوں کا یہ بھی کہنا تھا کہ ماضی میں وفاقی ملازمتوں کے معاملے میں بلوچستان کے مختلف اضلاع کو اکثر نظرانداز کیا جاتا تھا، جس سے مایوسی پھیلتی تھی۔ اب ان اقدامات کی بدولت نوجوانوں میں امید کی ایک نئی کرن بیدار ہوئی ہے، اور انہوں نے روزگار کے مواقع فراہم کرنے پر وفاقی و صوبائی حکومتوں کے ساتھ عسکری قیادت کا تہہ دل سے شکریہ ادا کیا ہے۔

stories.title: Harry Kane sidelined with ankle injury after Bayern draws with Cologne
stories.summary:
Bayern Munich forward Harry Kane faces a multi-month recovery after sustaining a torn ankle ligament during a 1-1 Bundesliga home draw against Cologne at the Allianz Arena on November 20, 2026. The England striker was forced off in the first half following a challenge from defender Joel Schmied, with club medical staff currently evaluating whether surgery is necessary.

The match saw Tottenham Hotspur loanee Mikey Moore open the scoring for Cologne after 12 minutes following a counter-attack sparked by a misplaced pass from Michael Olise. Bayern responded before the interval when Nathaniel Brown struck a low shot into the bottom right corner to equalize. Cologne nearly secured their first victory in Munich since 2009 late in the game, but El Mala missed a one-on-one opportunity against goalkeeper Jonas Urbig.

Alongside Kane, Bayern suffered further personnel setbacks when Olise sustained an injury that forced him off at half-time. The defending champions also managed the return of coach Vincent Kompany—who wore an arm sling following a shoulder dislocation in October—and midfielder Jamal Musiala, while remaining without several key players including Manuel Neuer and Alphonso Davies.

Despite dropping two points, Bayern remains the only undefeated side across Europe's top five leagues in all competitions. The result leaves Borussia Dortmund one point behind, with an opportunity to claim the top spot in the league table by defeating Borussia Moenchengladbach. Bayern's next fixture is an away match against Lille in the Champions League.
